component.name: Cubiq Launcher
component.summary: Minecraft launcher for every version and mod loader
Minecraft-Launcher für alle Versionen und Modloader
Launcher de Minecraft para todas las versiones y cargadores de mods

description.p: Cubiq Launcher is a Minecraft: Java Edition launcher with instances for every game version and every mod loader – Vanilla, Fabric, Quilt, Forge and NeoForge.

ul.li: Sign in with your Microsoft account
Browse and install mods, resource packs, shaders and modpacks from Modrinth and CurseForge
Import instances from the official launcher, Prism Launcher, MultiMC, the Modrinth App and CurseForge
Java is downloaded automatically in the right version
Server list, skins, screenshots, crash diagnosis and the optional Cubiq Client mod

description.p: A Minecraft: Java Edition account is required to play.
